# Bulk unmeasured e2e specs skew shard 1/15 into the 6-minute ceiling

Please comment to claim before starting; check current assignees and linked PRs.

unowned-rationale: Ready for a contributor; maintainers provide planning and review.

## Context

Two independent `e2e-engine (1/15)` CI runs hit the 6-minute (`360s`) step ceiling on 2026-11-21 with **100% of executed tests passing**:

- PR `#21766` ([job `136782504763`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/44880564885/job/136782504763), defect-note `MESSAGE:023cd3db`): `57 passed (6.0m)` (`362s`) -> killed at `timeout-minutes: 6`.
- PR `#21769` ([job `136792762453`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/44886466035/job/136792762453)): `38 passed (6.1m)` (`368s`) -> killed at `timeout-minutes: 6`.

Across the five completed green 15-shard runs on 2026-11-21 (`44883471766`, `44883100147`, `44880123498`, `44878141569`, `44876901023`), shards `1/15` and `2/15` consistently ran in `305-340s` while shards `5/15`, `6/15`, and `12/15` finished in `195-225s` — a `110-125s` systematic spread across shards that `balancedShard()` plans identically at `367-368s`.

## The Problem

`#21493` rebuilt `buildScripts/util/e2eEngineDurations.json` at `243` files and switched `durationOf()`'s unmeasured-file fallback from the table's median to its 90th percentile (`38.5s` on today's table). That fallback works when `1-5` files are missing, because a single over-priced file leaves its own shard light and spreads `(38.5s - actual) / 15` across the other 14 shards.

Since 2026-11-19, `44` new example/component E2E specs joined `enginePaths()` (`287` executed specs vs `243` entries in `e2eEngineDurations.json`, verified via `node --input-type=module` importing `enginePaths`, `balancedShard`, and `ENGINE_DURATIONS` from `buildScripts/util/e2eCiSelection.mjs` at `7cd0d6618e` / `beb96c739a`). When `44` unmeasured specs (`~3` per shard) enter `balancedShard()`'s single greedy pass at `p90 = 38.5s` (ahead of 90% of measured files):

1. Shard `1/15` starts with `workstation/WorkstationFilmTourNL.spec.mjs` (`166.4s`) and shard `2/15` starts with `portal/ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs` (`130.4s`), while shards `5/15` and `6/15` start at `73.3s` and `72.4s`.
2. Before shard `1/15` catches up in planned seconds, shards `5/15` and `6/15` absorb **4** unmeasured specs (`154.0s` of `p90` budget for lightweight example specs) and shards `3..4, 7..15` absorb **3** (`115.5s`), while shard `1/15` receives **1** (`38.5s`) and shard `2/15` receives **2** (`77.0s`).
3. The remaining ~219 measured specs (`< 38.5s`) then equalize all 15 shards to `367-368s` planned seconds — concentrating **`328.6s` of real measured work** onto shard `1/15` (`291.5s` onto shard `2/15`) vs **`213.1-214.4s` of real measured work** on shards `5/15` and `6/15`.

## The Architectural Reality

Design authority: `"the ceiling is six minutes of test time per shard … A shard nearing it gets its slow spec fixed first, and a sibling only when the runner budget has room"` (`.github/workflows/test.yml:465-469`).

- `buildScripts/util/e2eCiSelection.mjs:221`: `ENGINE_DURATIONS` loads `buildScripts/util/e2eEngineDurations.json` (`243` entries vs `287` `enginePaths()` files).
- `buildScripts/util/e2eCiSelection.mjs:409-443`: `durationOf(durations)` prices unmeasured files at `known[Math.floor(known.length * .9)]` (`38.5s`), and `balancedShard({paths, shard, durations})` sorts `paths` in one pass by `seconds(b) - seconds(a) || (a < b ? -1 : 1)`.
- Because unmeasured files carry identical unknown expected cost, letting heavy measured outliers (`166.4s`, `130.4s`) crowd unmeasured files onto other shards starves shard `1/15` of fallback headroom whenever a batch of specs lands between table rebuilds.
- Placing unmeasured files onto the lightest shards **first** (before known files are balanced longest-first on top) deals `44` unmeasured files evenly (`3` on 14 shards, `2` on 1 shard), lowering the heaviest shard's known load on today's stale table from `328.6s` to `291.4s` (`251.6-253.0s` across the other 14 shards) while preserving `#21493`'s single-missing-file behavior (`1` missing file still plans at `p90` and leaves its shard `p90` lighter in known work).

## The Fix

1. **Spread unmeasured specs evenly before balancing known specs in `balancedShard()` (`buildScripts/util/e2eCiSelection.mjs:430-443`):**
   Sort unmeasured files (`!(path in durations)`) ahead of measured files in `balancedShard()` (`(a in durations) - (b in durations) || seconds(b) - seconds(a) || (a < b ? -1 : 1)`), and document why in `balancedShard`'s JSDoc: unknown-cost files distribute `floor(K/M)..ceil(K/M)` per shard first so multi-spec waves cannot concentrate real measured load onto the shard holding the single longest spec.
2. **Rebuild `buildScripts/util/e2eEngineDurations.json` from >= 5 recent completed full-matrix green runs:**
   Use `gh run view <id> --repo neomjs/neo --log` passed to `node buildScripts/util/e2eCiSelection.mjs --engine-durations run1.log run2.log ... > buildScripts/util/e2eEngineDurations.json` (candidate green 15-shard runs from 2026-11-21: `44883471766`, `44883100147`, `44880123498`, `44878141569`, `44876901023`, or fresher completed full runs at pickup time) so every file in `enginePaths()` carries a measured per-run-max duration.
3. **Pin bulk-unmeasured balancing in `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/E2eCiSelection.spec.mjs`:**
   Add a deterministic unit arm (red on `dev`) with one heavy measured outlier (`160s`), smaller measured files (`10-35s`), and multiple unmeasured files (`K >= 2 * shards`), asserting that unmeasured files differ by at most `1` across shards and do not pile disproportionate known seconds onto shard `1`.

## Contract Ledger Matrix

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `balancedShard({paths, shard, durations})` (`buildScripts/util/e2eCiSelection.mjs:430`) | `balancedShard` & `durationOf` JSDoc (`:402-429`) | Deals unmeasured files (`!(path in durations)`, each priced at `p90`) across shards first, then balances measured files longest-first on top | Empty `durations` (`{}`) still returns `seconds: 0`; 0 or 1 missing file matches existing `p90` split | `balancedShard` JSDoc in `e2eCiSelection.mjs` | `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/E2eCiSelection.spec.mjs` |

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: `balancedShard()` deals unmeasured files (`!(path in durations)`) before measured files so unmeasured file counts per shard differ by at most `1`, pinned by a new unit test in `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/E2eCiSelection.spec.mjs` that fails on `dev` and passes on the branch (`npx playwright test --config test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/E2eCiSelection.spec.mjs`).
- [ ] AC-2: `buildScripts/util/e2eEngineDurations.json` holds a measured duration for every current `enginePaths()` file, rebuilt via `--engine-durations` from at least 5 completed full-matrix runs named in the PR body.
- [ ] AC-3: The PR body records per-shard planned seconds before and after the table rebuild, plus the stale-table per-shard known-seconds range before (`213.1-328.6s`) and after (`251.6-291.4s`) the `balancedShard()` ordering fix.

## Out of Scope

- Adding a 16th `e2e-engine` shard (declined in `#21493` under the 20-runner org pool budget).
- Raising `.github/workflows/test.yml:633`'s `timeout-minutes: 6` ceiling (ruled out by `.github/workflows/test.yml:465-469`).
- Scheduled automatic table commits in CI (out of scope per `#21259`, `#21287`, and `#21493`).
- `e2e-brain` shard durations.

## Avoided Traps

- **Changing `durationOf()` back to the median or mean:** `#21493` proved median under-plans single heavy new specs (`11/17` exceeded the median) and puts the entire error onto one shard. Keeping `p90` while dealing unmeasured files first preserves single-file headroom and eliminates multi-file starvation of shard `1/15`.
- **Rebuilding `e2eEngineDurations.json` without fixing `balancedShard()`:** Another wave of 30-40 Engine 14 / post-cut example specs would reproduce the exact `328.6s vs 213.1s` real-work skew onto shard `1/15`.
- **Pooling 20-30 historical runs from older spec versions:** `#21493` Avoided Traps showed stale per-file maxima from older spec revisions unbalance current splits; use `5-8` recent full-matrix runs.
